# Renew-It

> Dubai-based Corporate Service Provider for UAE renewals — trade licenses, visas, Emirates IDs, Golden Visas, company formation and government services across all 7 Emirates.

Renew-It helps individuals, families and businesses keep UAE documents valid, compliant and up to date. Quotations clearly separate government fees, third-party costs and the Renew-It service fee. The team provides reminders before documents expire.

- Website: https://www.renew-it.ae
- Languages: English (primary), Arabic and 10+ languages supported by the team
- Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Coverage: All 7 Emirates

## What we renew

### Company & Corporate
- Trade Licenses
- Free Zone Licenses
- Mainland Licenses
- Establishment Cards
- Immigration Cards
- Corporate Documents
- Government Permits & Approvals

### Visas & Residency
- Investor Visas
- Golden Visas
- Partner Visas
- Family & Dependent Visas
- Employee Visas
- Residence Visas
- Emirates IDs

### Other Renewals
- Work Permits
- Government Approvals
- Regulatory Documents
- Other documents with an expiry or renewal date

## Beyond renewals

Renew-It also supports company formation, Golden Visa applications, pro services and broader corporate and immigration support in the UAE.

## How it works

1. Share your document or renewal requirement
2. Receive a clear quote with fee breakdown
3. We process the renewal with UAE authorities
4. Get your renewed document and official receipts where available

## Pricing transparency

- Government & regulator fees — shown separately
- Third-party costs — medical, insurance, courier, typing where applicable
- Renew-It service fee — always shown separately
- Official payment vouchers and receipts where available

## Reminders

Renew-It can track expiry dates and send reminders before the next renewal is due.

## Frequently asked questions

### What documents can you renew?
Personal, residency, corporate and government-related renewals including trade licenses, visas, Emirates IDs, immigration cards, establishment cards, permits and approvals.

### How much does a renewal cost?
Depends on document type and authority. You receive a clear breakdown before work starts.

### Will I see government fees separately?
Yes. Government and third-party charges are separated from the Renew-It service fee.

### Can you handle renewals outside Dubai?
Yes — across all 7 Emirates.

### Do I need to visit your office?
Many renewals can be coordinated remotely. Physical presence is advised only when required by the authority.
